title: github-pr-explorer page layout
description: One page layout: layouts/<id>.json in the configuration folder (~/Library/Application Support/github-pr-explorer/config). A layout arranges a pull request's blocks in named tabs, each split into columns. The file must be named after the layout's id. A file whose id is a built-in layout's (decision-first, tabbed) replaces that layout. A file that does not validate is not applied, and the app keeps using the last version that worked.

$schema.description: Optional. A link to this schema, for editors. The app ignores it.

formatVersion.description: The version of this file's format. This app reads version 1 only.

id.description: Stable and file-name safe: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit, such as my-layout. The file is layouts/<id>.json, and settings.json's defaultLayout names a layout by this.

name.description: What a person sees in the layout menu and in Settings, such as "Decision first". Not empty.

tabs.description: The page's tabs, in order. At least one. A layout with one tab shows no tab strip.

name.description: The tab's title in the tab strip. Not empty.

columns.description: The tab's columns, left to right. May be empty, for a tab with no blocks yet.

width.description: The column's share of the tab's width, relative to the other columns: widths 2 and 1 give two thirds and one third. A number above zero.

blocks.description: The column's blocks, top to bottom. May be empty.

block.description: One block placed on the page.

kind.description: Which block: description, checks, reviewers, ownersTouched (code owners whose files the pull request changes), files, threads (review threads), activity (the timeline), commits, or labelsAndMetadata.

size.description: How much the block shows: small is a line or two, large is its full content. Every block works at both sizes.
